priority_order: Small and newly established employers with suitable roles
Remote jobs as a secondary option

salary_priority.rule: Prefer and boost jobs explicitly offering PKR 60,000+; do not exclude lower-paying jobs when the role is a strong urgent-job match.

company_size_policy: Do not reject small, local, startup, newly established, or lesser-known employers merely because of company size. Also actively target established national companies and international multinationals.
urgent_job_policy: Keep matching broad enough to surface legitimate Graphic Designer and business/computer roles from small employers, local companies, established national companies, multinational companies, social-media job advertisements, and direct employer postings.
auto_apply_policy: Never bypass CAPTCHA, 2FA, login walls, platform restrictions or employer controls. Auto-send email only when configured and permitted; WhatsApp/phone are prepared for human action unless a compliant integration is explicitly configured.

search_strategy.google_discovery: Use Google-indexed web results to discover current vacancies on employer-owned career pages and direct application pages, not only job boards.
search_strategy.company_websites: Search national Pakistani companies, multinational companies, international employers, and their ATS/career domains directly through Google-indexed results.
search_strategy.direct_application: Prefer the employer's own application URL when a vacancy is found on a company career site; otherwise use the source's application method.
search_strategy.google_jobs: Include Google Jobs/Search discovery alongside Indeed, Rozee.pk, Glassdoor, Pakistani job boards, social posts, and direct employer career pages.
